ultimate_hawkeye.title: THE AVENGING ARCHER
ultimate_hawkeye.text: Clint Barton proved he never misses, raining arrows from across the city while seamlessly turning the enemy's own attacks against them.

deck.name: Master Marksman
deck.effect_text: This turn, you can treat each symbol on the Storyline as ✸ ✸.

deck.name: Martial Artist
deck.effect_text: Until the beginning of your next turn, any damage you would take can be redirected to enemies in your Location.
